capabilities: Replace the new tab view with a customizable dashboard
Rotate background images by theme, season, custom URL, vault image, or transparency
Show clock, greeting, and random quote widgets with show/hide settings
List recently updated files and bookmarks on the tab
Configure search buttons to open selected search plugins
extras: Backgrounds and quotes are fetched from external services; custom local images are desktop-only.
problem: Obsidian's default new tab is blank, so there is no welcoming start page with useful at-a-glance information when opening the vault.

relations.evidence: Inspired by the excellent Chrome extension Momentum
Quotes are pulled from the quoteable API

summary: New tab dashboard that replaces empty tabs with customizable backgrounds, clock, greeting, quotes, search, recent files, and bookmarks.
